description: Search records in a table for a text term, across all text fields or a chosen subset.

baseId.description: ID of the Airtable base containing the table.

fieldIds.description: Optional list of field IDs to restrict the search to; when omitted, all fields are searched.

maxRecords.description: Maximum number of records to search through; defaults to 100.

searchTerm.description: Text term to search for in record field values; matching is case-insensitive.

tableId.description: ID of the table to search records in.

name: search_records
